The pristine world satisfies neither half: AvailabilityRecord(**entry) raises TypeError on any unknown or omitted-optional field.

codes.positive: At least one NEW test file feeds the client canned response payloads spanning the variations the vendored doc permits, entirely offline via a stub transport: at minimum one case where an item entry carries a field unknown to the client, and one case where discount_pct and/or restock_eta is omitted, each asserting availability records come back with correct values.
